audit.why: 47.66% over 1175 games with Garen holding almost every lane stage until Poppy's items arrive. Difficulty 6/10 understates it slightly but the mirror kept the same framing, so it is left alone rather than desynced.
audit.corrected: Kept 6/10 difficulty, 7/10 carry threat; lane is Garen's until 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2, 3 and 6 were marked 'Skill' on both layers while the mirror had already flipped all three to Garen at 6/10.
audit.why: The whys already read as Garen-favoured at 2 and 3 ('the combo fizzles', 'your flat damage can't close'), so the side tokens were the outlier. Level 6 needed the why softened too, since Poppy's R interrupts the execute but does not flip the stage.
audit.corrected: phases[1|2|4].side and win[1|2|4] flipped to Garen as one group, ratings inverted from the mirror's 6/10 to 4/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the player four separate times that Steadfast Presence answers Garen's engage — 'W any dash he tries', 'W deletes his dash mid-flight', 'Use W to deny his step-in entirely', 'W shuts off his engage'. Garen has no dash.
audit.why: Decisive Strike is a Move Speed burst that also breaks slows; it walks straight through the W ring. W gives Poppy movement speed and its low-health resist scaling here, nothing more. The mirror agent flagged exactly this and asked that Poppy's page not repeat it.
audit.corrected: Every dash-stop claim replaced. W is now described as resists and speed; the real interactions stated are Decisive Strike's silence (8s, auto-attack reset) killing the Q follow-up after E, Courage's shield/tenacity eating the burst and shrugging the E stun, and Keeper's Verdict interrupting Demacian Justice.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block gave no numbers and described Courage only as 'damage reduction'.
audit.why: Courage is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s and grants a shield plus tenacity first, then the lesser damage reduction. The tenacity is why the E stun feels short. Decisive Strike is 8s flat.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with both timers and the shield/tenacity ordering.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2] is titled 'Let him reset with regen' but the body was a copy of the wall-stun trade line.
audit.why: Perseverance regenerates a percentage of total health per second once he has not been struck recently — that is the actual mistake being described.
audit.corrected: Body now names Perseverance and the out-of-combat condition.

edits.before: E-wall-stun him — W his spin, bait his W. Poppy wins the Courage cooldown windows.
edits.after: Bait Courage (22s), then E-wall-stun. Garen has no dash — W gives you resists, not a stop.

edits.before: W deletes his dash mid-flight — hold it like a parry. Only take the trade when Garen's Courage is down.
edits.after: Garen has no dash for W to stop — Decisive Strike's silence beats your combo, so give up the level-2 trade.

edits.before: Keeper’s Verdict punts the fight’s biggest threat across the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Garen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict can interrupt Demacian Justice, but his true-damage execute means low HP is still lethal — his window, not yours.

edits.before: E Garen into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: E Garen into a wall once Decisive Strike (8s) is spent, Q the zone under him, and only after Courage's shield has been burned.

edits.before: E Garen into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: E Garen into a wall once Decisive Strike (8s) is spent, Q the zone under him, and only after Courage's shield has been burned.

edits.before: Garen wastes Courage — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Courage's shield eats your burst — wait the 22s out, then commit.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: Perseverance heals him back the second you stop hitting — chip him or leave him alone.

edits.before: - Garen Courage: matchup-defining — Damage reduction. Trade when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Courage (22/19.5/17/14.5/12s): shield and tenacity first, damage reduction after — bait it, never trade into it. - Decisive Strike (8s): silence on his next auto. - Keeper's Verdict: save it to break his R.

edits.before: Your R is a genuine answer here — charge it to fling him off or tap it to interrupt his R execute, evening the all-in.
edits.after: Your R interrupts Demacian Justice and flings him off, but Courage's tenacity and his silence still edge the all-in his way.

edits.before: Your Q+E wall-stun combo is online, but Garen can just W-mitigate the trade and Q-silence your follow-up Q before you reach a wall.
edits.after: Your Q+E wall-stun is online, but Courage mitigates the trade and Decisive Strike's silence kills your follow-up before you reach a wall.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay in his favor — your damage doesn't scale with ability points, so he keeps winning the short trade and disengaging on his terms. Level 6 is where you stabilize: your R is a real answer to his all-in, either charging it to fling him away from a fight he wants or tapping it to interrupt the moment he goes for the R execute. Use W to deny his step-in entirely and chunk him with max-HP Q rather than chasing — chasing just walks you into his Q-silence and passive regen.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay in his favor — your damage doesn't scale with ability points, so he keeps winning the short trade and disengaging on his terms. At 6 your R helps but does not flip the lane: charge it to fling him out of a fight he wants, or tap it to interrupt Demacian Justice before the execute lands. W stops nothing here — Garen has no dash — so use its passive resists to tank, and chunk him with max-HP Q instead of chasing into Decisive Strike's silence and his Perseverance regen.

edits.before: This is where you finally pull ahead — your cheap tank/bruiser items and gold-independent kit hold up while his Q-strike trade damage flattens out. Your max-HP Q keeps chunking him no matter his build, W shuts off his engage, and E-into-wall is an unconditional stun in skirmishes. The one thing that still kills you is his R: it's missing-HP true damage and ignores your armor stacking, so don't let yourself drop low in his range — stay topped up, peel with W and R, and frontline rather than dueling him at execute HP.
edits.after: This is where you finally pull ahead — your cheap tank/bruiser items and gold-independent kit hold up while his Decisive Strike trade damage flattens out. Your max-HP Q keeps chunking him no matter his build, W's resists scale up as you drop low, and E-into-wall is a real stun in skirmishes. The one thing that still kills you is his R: it's missing-HP true damage and ignores your armor stacking, so don't drop low in his range — stay topped up, peel with W and R, and frontline rather than dueling him at execute HP.

edits.before: Use W to body-block his engage and grind him with max-HP Q while you out-sustain his short trades
edits.after: Lean on W's low-health resist scaling and grind him with max-HP Q through his short trades

notes: dosFull[2].t reads 'W-tank his Q-E' — 14 characters, under the applier's 25-character skip threshold, so it cannot be fixed through a normal edit. It should become something like 'Wait out Courage before you commit', since W does not tank Judgment in any special way and the current title implies a W interaction that does not exist. Two Garen kit flags are worth noting: Decisive Strike carries a 'zone' flag Riot's text does not support (it is a single-target empowered auto), and Poppy's own E carries a 'terrain: creates terrain' flag that is also a parse misfire — she pushes targets INTO existing terrain, she does not create it. Nothing was written from either flag.
